claims.statement: The read-only QueryTools interface defines pod_status, recent_events, logs, metrics, and recent_changes, has deliberately no write/patch/delete tool, and ships a StubQueryTools returning deterministic demo data so the pipeline runs with no cluster.

The Kubernetes client supports kubeconfig_mode auto (in-cluster if a ServiceAccount token exists else kubeconfig), incluster, and local, is used read-only with only list_ and read_ calls, and imports the kubernetes dependency lazily from the [cluster] extra.
Prometheus metrics are optional via PromQL in the metrics tool, with prometheus_url unset by default and metrics skipped gracefully while pod status, events, logs, and changes still work.

The optional LLM sidecar is a local llama.cpp server serving a GGUF model, makes zero outbound calls, is bound to loopback 127.0.0.1, and any error or timeout falls back to the deterministic extractive order.

The service-area impact workbook loader reads the '20-section map' and 'Pod map' sheets, ignores the 'Alert mapping detail' sheet, matches pods on a hash-stripped stem, and produces additive impact context that is explicitly not a cause and never changes hypothesis ranking.
